title: Finding
description: A single classified claim produced during incident orchestration (prompts/01_incident_orchestrator.md, section 4/6). Every finding must be typed and evidence-cited so that facts, inferences, and hypotheses remain distinguishable downstream.

finding_id.description: Stable identifier for this finding, e.g. F-001.

claim_type.description: Which of the seven required orchestrator categories (A-F; decisions requiring approval are modeled separately, see decision_matrix.schema.json) this finding belongs to.

statement.description: The claim itself, in plain language.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence IDs from evidence_manifest.yaml this finding rests on. May be empty only when claim_type is 'unresolved_question' or 'missing_evidence'.

opposing_evidence_ids.description: For competing_hypothesis or contradiction findings: evidence that weighs against the statement.

confidence_rationale.description: Why this confidence level, referencing the evidence_ids.

hypothesis_ref.description: For findings tied to a named hypothesis (e.g. H1-H4), the hypothesis identifier.
